disagreement.independent_candidate: At 150 MPa, Brass is of order 10^5 cycles and Al 2024 is about 2e7 to 3e7 cycles; SAE 1045 is below its approximately 310 MPa endurance plateau.
disagreement.legacy_candidate: Brass about 1.0e4 cycles, Al 2024 about 5.4e6 cycles and SAE 1045 endurance limit about 315 MPa.

source_review.finding: The 150 MPa horizontal meets the Brass curve near 10^5 and the Al 2024 curve between 10^7 and 10^8, visibly much closer to the independent ranges than to the legacy values. The steel plateau reads approximately 310 to 315 MPa.

review_reasoning: The N axis is logarithmic; equal horizontal distances are decades, not equal cycle increments.
At 10^4 the Brass curve is only beginning above 150 MPa, so 1.0e4 cannot be the visible 150 MPa intersection.
At about 5.4e6 the Al curve is still visibly above 150 MPa; the intersection occurs later, at a few times 10^7.
The 310 versus 315 MPa endurance reading is within source raster thickness and leaves the rounded design diameter unchanged at 19 mm.
reviewed_exam_answer_ru: При S=150 МПа: SAE 1045 — ниже предела выносливости; Al 2024 — примерно 2·10^7…3·10^7 циклов; латунь — порядка 10^5 циклов.
По графику σ_e≈310…315 МПа; расчёт даёт d_min≈18,8…19,0 мм, поэтому выбирают не менее 19 мм до учёта проектных коэффициентов.
